scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "API,WEB" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/financial-engine && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/financial-engine && npm run test -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w packages/financial-engine && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
